            { "label": "Gemini 2.5 Pro",            "provider": "gemini", "id": "gemini-2.5-pro",             "isFree": false, "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 2048 },
            { "label": "Gemini 2.5 Flash (Free)",   "provider": "gemini", "id": "gemini-2.5-flash",           "isFree": true,  "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 2048 },

            { "label": "Claude 4 Sonnet",           "provider": "claude", "id": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",   "isFree": false, "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 2048 },
            { "label": "Claude 3.7 Sonnet",         "provider": "claude", "id": "claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219", "isFree": false, "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 2048 },
            { "label": "Claude 3.5 Sonnet",         "provider": "claude", "id": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022", "isFree": false, "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 2048 },
            { "label": "Claude 3.5 Haiku",          "provider": "claude", "id": "claude-3-5-haiku-20241022",  "isFree": true,  "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 2048 },
            { "label": "OpenAI GPT-4o",             "provider": "openai", "id": "gpt-4o",                     "isFree": false, "enabled": true, "maxOutputTokens": 1500 },

        property real popupAnchorY: parent.height / 2 - 120

        TextEdit {
            id: hiddenClipboardBridge
            visible: false

        // Quét tự động thư mục /home/root/AI_Notes/extensions/
        FolderListModel {
            id: extensionFolderScanner
            folder: "file:///home/root/AI_Notes/extensions"
            showDirs: false
            showDotAndDotDot: false
            sortField: FolderListModel.Name
            onStatusChanged: {
                if (extensionFolderScanner.status === FolderListModel.Ready) {
                    aiOverlayRoot.scanAndLoadExtensions();
                }
            }
        }

        Component.onCompleted: {
            loadDisabledExtensionsState();
            rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels();
            initAndLoadNotebookDB();
            loadApiKeysDirectlyFromTxt(true);
            scanAndLoadExtensions();
        }

        function suppressSystemKeyboard() {
            try { Qt.inputMethod.hide(); } catch (e) {}
        }

        function replaceAllStr(src, findStr, repStr) {
            if (!src) return "";
            return src.split(findStr).join(repStr);
        }

        function cleanKeyString(s) {
            if (!s) return "";
            var out = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
                var ch = s.charAt(i);
                if (ch !== " " && ch !== "\r" && ch !== "\n" && ch !== "\t" && ch !== "\"" && ch !== "'") {
                    out += ch;
                }
            }
            return out;
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // HỆ THỐNG NẠP ĐỘNG & BẬT/TẮT EXTENSION (/home/root/AI_Notes/extensions/)
        // =========================================================================
        function loadDisabledExtensionsState() {
            var map = {};
            try {
                var arr = JSON.parse(persistentSettings.disabledExtensionsJson || "[]");
                for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    map[arr[i]] = true;
                }
            } catch (e) {}
            disabledExtensionsMap = map;
        }

        function saveDisabledExtensionsState() {
            var arr = [];
            for (var k in disabledExtensionsMap) {
                if (disabledExtensionsMap[k] === true) {
                    arr.push(k);
                }
            }
            persistentSettings.disabledExtensionsJson = JSON.stringify(arr);
        }

        function isExtensionEnabled(extId) {
            return !(disabledExtensionsMap[extId] === true);
        }

        function toggleExtensionEnabled(extId) {
            var copyMap = {};
            for (var k in disabledExtensionsMap) {
                copyMap[k] = disabledExtensionsMap[k];
            }
            if (copyMap[extId] === true) {
                copyMap[extId] = false;
                showToast("✓ Đã BẬT tiện ích!");
            } else {
                copyMap[extId] = true;
                showToast("✓ Đã TẮT tiện ích!");
            }
            disabledExtensionsMap = copyMap;
            saveDisabledExtensionsState();
            rebuildUtilityMenuItems();
        }

        // Tìm trực tiếp đối tượng QML sống trong extensionHostContainer (Không qua mảng var trung gian)
        function findExtensionObjectById(extId) {
            if (!extensionHostContainer || !extensionHostContainer.children) return null;
            var kids = extensionHostContainer.children;
            for (var i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
                var child = kids[i];
                if (child && child.extensionId === extId) {
                    return child;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        // Tạo danh sách phẳng 1 cấp cho Dropdown "Tiện ích ▾" (Giống hệt availableModels)
        function rebuildUtilityMenuItems() {
            var flatList = [];
            flatList.push({
                "rowType": "builtin",
                "extId": "core",
                "actionId": "save_notebook",
                "label": "📚 Lưu phiên hiện tại vào Sổ tay nội bộ",
                "isEnabled": true
            });
            flatList.push({
                "rowType": "builtin",
                "extId": "core",
                "actionId": "copy_all",
                "label": "📋 Chép toàn bộ lịch sử Chat vào Clipboard",
                "isEnabled": true
            });

            for (var i = 0; i < loadedExtensions.length; i++) {
                var ext = loadedExtensions[i];
                var active = isExtensionEnabled(ext.extensionId);
                flatList.push({
                    "rowType": "toggle",
                    "extId": ext.extensionId,
                    "actionId": "toggle_ext",
                    "label": (active ? "[✓] BẬT: " : "[  ] TẮT: ") + ext.extensionName,
                    "isEnabled": active
                });

                if (active && ext.extensionActions) {
                    for (var a = 0; a < ext.extensionActions.length; a++) {
                        var act = ext.extensionActions[a];
                        var code = act.actionId || act.id || "";
                        var textLabel = act.label || code;
                        flatList.push({
                            "rowType": "action",
                            "extId": ext.extensionId,
                            "actionId": code,
                            "label": "   ▸ " + textLabel,
                            "isEnabled": true
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            utilityMenuItems = flatList;
        }

        function scanAndLoadExtensions() {
            var candidateUrls = [];
            var count = extensionFolderScanner.count;
            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                var fName = extensionFolderScanner.get(i, "fileName");
                var fUrl = extensionFolderScanner.get(i, "fileURL").toString();
                if (fName && fName.length > 4 && fName.substring(fName.length - 4) === ".qml") {
                    candidateUrls.push(fUrl);
                }
            }

            var defaultExtFiles = ["epubPdfExporter.qml", "guideExtension.qml"];
            for (var d = 0; d < defaultExtFiles.length; d++) {
                var defUrl = "file:///home/root/AI_Notes/extensions/" + defaultExtFiles[d];
                var existed = false;
                for (var c = 0; c < candidateUrls.length; c++) {
                    if (candidateUrls[c].indexOf(defaultExtFiles[d]) !== -1) {
                        existed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!existed) candidateUrls.push(defUrl);
            }

            for (var u = 0; u < candidateUrls.length; u++) {
                try {
                    var comp = Qt.createComponent(candidateUrls[u]);
                    if (comp.status === Component.Ready) {
                        var tempObj = comp.createObject(extensionHostContainer);
                        if (tempObj && tempObj.extensionId) {
                            // Kiểm tra nếu đã nạp extensionId này rồi thì hủy bản trùng lặp
                            var existingCount = 0;
                            var kids = extensionHostContainer.children;
                            for (var k = 0; k < kids.length; k++) {
                                if (kids[k] && kids[k].extensionId === tempObj.extensionId) {
                                    existingCount++;
                                }
                            }
                            if (existingCount > 1) {
                                tempObj.destroy();
                            }
                        } else if (tempObj) {
                            tempObj.destroy();
                        }
                    }
                } catch (err) {}
            }

            // Đọc danh sách metadata từ các QObject đang sống trong extensionHostContainer
            var metaList = [];
            if (extensionHostContainer && extensionHostContainer.children) {
                var hostKids = extensionHostContainer.children;
                for (var h = 0; h < hostKids.length; h++) {
                    var inst = hostKids[h];
                    if (inst && inst.extensionId) {
                        var actionsCopy = [];
                        if (inst.extensionActions) {
                            for (var ac = 0; ac < inst.extensionActions.length; ac++) {
                                actionsCopy.push({
                                    "actionId": inst.extensionActions[ac].actionId || inst.extensionActions[ac].id || "",
                                    "label": inst.extensionActions[ac].label || ""
                                });
                            }
                        }
                        metaList.push({
                            "extensionId": inst.extensionId,
                            "extensionName": inst.extensionName || inst.extensionId,
                            "extensionDescription": inst.extensionDescription || "",
                            "extensionActions": actionsCopy
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            loadedExtensions = metaList;
            rebuildUtilityMenuItems();
        }

        function buildChatContextData(customTitle, customTranscriptText) {
            var sessionMsgs = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < chatLogModel.count; i++) {
                var row = chatLogModel.get(i);
                sessionMsgs.push({
                    "sender": row.sender === "Bạn" ? "user" : "ai",
                    "senderLabel": row.sender,
                    "text": row.msgText,
                    "timestamp": Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(), "hh:mm")
                });
            }

            var activeModelLabel = "AI Assistant";
            if (availableModels.length > 0 && currentModelIndex >= 0 && currentModelIndex < availableModels.length) {
                activeModelLabel = availableModels[currentModelIndex].label;
            }

            return {
                "title": customTitle || aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle,
                "currentSession": sessionMsgs,
                "transcriptText": customTranscriptText || buildTranscriptMarkdown(),
                "activeModel": activeModelLabel,
                "deviceModel": persistentSettings.deviceModelName
            };
        }

        function triggerExtensionActionById(extId, actionId, customContext) {
            if (!isExtensionEnabled(extId)) {
                showToast("⚠ Tiện ích này đang tắt! Hãy bật [✓] trong menu [Tiện ích ▾].");
                return;
            }
            var liveObj = findExtensionObjectById(extId);
            if (!liveObj || typeof liveObj.executeAction !== "function") {
                showToast("⚠ Không tìm thấy hàm thực thi của tiện ích [" + extId + "]!");
                return;
            }
            var ctx = customContext || buildChatContextData("", "");
            try {
                liveObj.executeAction(actionId, ctx);
            } catch (e) {
                showToast("⚠ Lỗi thực thi tiện ích: " + e);
            }
        }

        function delegateExportToExtension(noteTitle, noteContent, formatActionId) {
            var targetExt = findExtensionObjectById("builtin_exporter");
            if (!targetExt) {
                targetExt = findExtensionObjectById("epub_pdf_exporter");
            }
            if (!targetExt) {
                showToast("⚠ Chưa tìm thấy tiện ích epubPdfExporter.qml trong /extensions/!");
                return;
            }
            if (!isExtensionEnabled(targetExt.extensionId)) {
                showToast("⚠ Tiện ích Xuất EPUB/PDF đang bị tắt trong menu [Tiện ích ▾]!");
                return;
            }
            var customSession = [];
            if (noteContent && noteContent !== "") {
                customSession.push({
                    "sender": "ai",
                    "senderLabel": "Nội dung Sổ tay",
                    "text": noteContent,
                    "timestamp": Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(), "hh:mm")
                });
            }
            var ctx = buildChatContextData(noteTitle || aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle, noteContent || "");
            if (customSession.length > 0) {
                ctx.currentSession = customSession;
            }
            triggerExtensionActionById(targetExt.extensionId, formatActionId || "export_epub", ctx);
        }
        // =========================================================================
        // HỆ THỐNG SỔ TAY QML NỘI BỘ (DÙNG Qt.labs.settings - KHÔNG CẦN SQLITE)
        // =========================================================================
        function initAndLoadNotebookDB() {
            savedNotebookModel.clear();
            try {
                var raw = persistentSettings.savedNotesJson || "[]";
                var arr = JSON.parse(raw);
                for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    var row = arr[i];
                    savedNotebookModel.append({
                        "noteId": row.noteId || "",
                        "title": row.title || "",
                        "createdAt": row.createdAt || "",
                        "content": row.content || ""
                    });
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function persistNotebookModelToSettings() {
            var arr = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < savedNotebookModel.count; i++) {
                var item = savedNotebookModel.get(i);
                arr.push({
                    "noteId": item.noteId,
                    "title": item.title,
                    "createdAt": item.createdAt,
                    "content": item.content
                });
            }
            persistentSettings.savedNotesJson = JSON.stringify(arr);
        }

        function buildTranscriptMarkdown() {
            var lines = [];
            lines.push("# " + aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle);
            lines.push("Thời gian: " + Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(), "dd/MM/yyyy hh:mm:ss"));
            lines.push("----------------------------------------\n");
            for (var i = 0; i < chatLogModel.count; i++) {
                var item = chatLogModel.get(i);
                lines.push("[" + item.sender + "]:");
                lines.push(item.msgText + "\n");
            }
            return lines.join("\n");
        }

        function saveCurrentChatToQMLNotebook(silentMode) {
            if (chatLogModel.count === 0) {
                if (!silentMode) showToast("⚠ Chưa có nội dung trò chuyện để lưu vào Sổ tay!");
                return false;
            }
            var fullText = buildTranscriptMarkdown();
            var nowStr = Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(), "dd/MM/yyyy hh:mm:ss");
            var firstQuestion = chatLogModel.get(0).msgText || aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle;
            if (firstQuestion.length > 48) {
                firstQuestion = firstQuestion.substring(0, 48) + "...";
            }
            var displayTitle = aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle + " - " + replaceAllStr(firstQuestion, "\n", " ");

            try {
                var updated = false;
                for (var i = 0; i < savedNotebookModel.count; i++) {
                    if (savedNotebookModel.get(i).noteId === aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle) {
                        savedNotebookModel.setProperty(i, "title", displayTitle);
                        savedNotebookModel.setProperty(i, "createdAt", nowStr);
                        savedNotebookModel.setProperty(i, "content", fullText);
                        updated = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) {
                    savedNotebookModel.insert(0, {
                        "noteId": aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle,
                        "title": displayTitle,
                        "createdAt": nowStr,
                        "content": fullText
                    });
                }
                persistNotebookModelToSettings();
                if (!silentMode) {
                    showToast("✓ Đã lưu vào [📚 Sổ tay] trong ứng dụng!");
                }
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                if (!silentMode) showToast("⚠ Không thể ghi vào Sổ tay nội bộ.");
                return false;
            }
        }

        function deleteNoteFromQMLNotebook(noteIdToDelete) {
            try {
                for (var i = 0; i < savedNotebookModel.count; i++) {
                    if (savedNotebookModel.get(i).noteId === noteIdToDelete) {
                        savedNotebookModel.remove(i);
                        break;
                    }
                }
                selectedNotebookIndex = -1;
                persistNotebookModelToSettings();
                showToast("✓ Đã xóa ghi chú khỏi Sổ tay!");
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // TÍNH TOÁN HẠN MỨC TOKEN & CHỈ THỊ THEO "MỨC ĐỘ TƯ DUY" (0 DẤU SAO)
        // =========================================================================
        function computeEffectiveMaxTokens(modelObj) {
            var baseLimit = (modelObj && modelObj.maxOutputTokens) ? modelObj.maxOutputTokens : 2048;
            if (aiOverlayRoot.thinkingLevel === "medium") {
                return baseLimit << 1; // Gấp đôi (2x)
            } else if (aiOverlayRoot.thinkingLevel === "high") {
                return baseLimit << 2; // Gấp bốn (4x)
            }
            return baseLimit; // Mức Thấp mặc định (1x)
        }

        function buildEffectiveSystemInstruction() {
            if (aiOverlayRoot.thinkingLevel === "medium") {
                return systemInstruction + " Hãy giải thích chi tiết, trình bày rõ các bước lập luận và kèm ví dụ minh họa.";
            } else if (aiOverlayRoot.thinkingLevel === "high") {
                return systemInstruction + " Hãy vận dụng tư duy sâu sắc nhất (Deep Step-by-Step Reasoning): phân tích đa chiều, lập luận chặt chẽ từng bước và cung cấp câu trả lời đầy đủ, trọn vẹn nhất mà không cắt bớt nội dung.";
            }
            return systemInstruction;
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // QUẢN LÝ BỘ LỌC & HỘP KIỂM CHỌN MODEL TRONG TRANG CÀI ĐẶT
        // =========================================================================
        function rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels() {
            var currentSelectedId = "";
            if (availableModels.length > 0 && currentModelIndex >= 0 && currentModelIndex < availableModels.length) {
                currentSelectedId = availableModels[currentModelIndex].id;
            }

            var activeList = [];
            var settingsList = [];
            var q = (modelSearchQuery || "").trim().toLowerCase();

            for (var i = 0; i < allModelsMaster.length; i++) {
                var item = allModelsMaster[i];
                if (item.enabled) {
                    activeList.push(item);
                }

                var matchProv = (selectedProviderFilter === "all" || item.provider === selectedProviderFilter);
                var matchQuery = (q === "" || item.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 || item.id.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1);
                if (matchProv && matchQuery) {
                    settingsList.push({
                        "masterIndex": i,
                        "label": item.label,
                        "provider": item.provider,
                        "id": item.id,
                        "isFree": item.isFree,
                        "enabled": item.enabled,
                        "maxOutputTokens": item.maxOutputTokens || 2048
                    });
                }
            }

            if (activeList.length === 0 && allModelsMaster.length > 0) {
                allModelsMaster[0].enabled = true;
                activeList.push(allModelsMaster[0]);
                if (settingsList.length > 0 && settingsList[0].masterIndex === 0) {
                    settingsList[0].enabled = true;
                }
            }

            availableModels = activeList;
            filteredSettingsModels = settingsList;

            var foundIdx = 0;
            for (var j = 0; j < availableModels.length; j++) {
                if (availableModels[j].id === currentSelectedId) {
                    foundIdx = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            currentModelIndex = foundIdx;
            verifyActiveApiConnection();
        }

        function toggleModelEnabledAtMaster(masterIdx) {
            if (masterIdx < 0 || masterIdx >= allModelsMaster.length) return;
            var copyMaster = [];
            var enabledCount = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < allModelsMaster.length; i++) {
                var m = allModelsMaster[i];
                var newEnabled = (i === masterIdx) ? (!m.enabled) : m.enabled;
                if (newEnabled) enabledCount++;
                copyMaster.push({
                    "label": m.label,
                    "provider": m.provider,
                    "id": m.id,
                    "isFree": m.isFree,
                    "enabled": newEnabled,
                    "maxOutputTokens": m.maxOutputTokens || 2048
                });
            }
            if (enabledCount === 0) {
                showToast("⚠ Cần giữ ít nhất 1 model được kích hoạt cho cửa sổ Chat!");
                return;
            }
            allModelsMaster = copyMaster;
            rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels();
        }

        function setBulkModelsEnabledForCurrentFilter(enableState) {
            var q = (modelSearchQuery || "").trim().toLowerCase();
            var copyMaster = [];
            var totalEnabled = 0;

            for (var i = 0; i < allModelsMaster.length; i++) {
                var m = allModelsMaster[i];
                var matchProv = (selectedProviderFilter === "all" || m.provider === selectedProviderFilter);
                var matchQuery = (q === "" || m.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 || m.id.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1);
                var nextState = (matchProv && matchQuery) ? enableState : m.enabled;
                if (nextState) totalEnabled++;
                copyMaster.push({
                    "label": m.label,
                    "provider": m.provider,
                    "id": m.id,
                    "isFree": m.isFree,
                    "enabled": nextState,
                    "maxOutputTokens": m.maxOutputTokens || 2048
                });
            }

            if (totalEnabled === 0 && copyMaster.length > 0) {
                copyMaster[0].enabled = true;
                showToast("✓ Đã bỏ chọn (Giữ lại 1 model mặc định cho cửa sổ Chat)!");
            }
            allModelsMaster = copyMaster;
            rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels();
        }

        function loadApiKeysDirectlyFromTxt(autoFetchAfterLoad) {
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/AI_Notes/api_keys.txt", true);
            xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                    if (xhr.status === 200 || xhr.status === 0) {
                        var lines = (xhr.responseText || "").split("\n");
                        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                            var line = lines[i].trim();
                            if (line.indexOf("GEMINI_KEY=") === 0) {
                                var gk = cleanKeyString(line.substring(11));
                                if (gk !== "" && gk !== "AIzaSy...") geminiApiKey = gk;
                            } else if (line.indexOf("CLAUDE_KEY=") === 0) {
                                var ck = cleanKeyString(line.substring(11));
                                if (ck !== "" && ck !== "sk-ant-...") anthropicApiKey = ck;
                            } else if (line.indexOf("OPENAI_KEY=") === 0) {
                                var ok = cleanKeyString(line.substring(11));
                                if (ok !== "" && ok !== "sk-proj-...") openaiApiKey = ok;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    verifyActiveApiConnection();
                    if (autoFetchAfterLoad && (geminiApiKey !== "" || anthropicApiKey !== "" || openaiApiKey !== "")) {
                        fetchAllAvailableModels();
                    }
                }
            };
            xhr.send();
        }

        function verifyActiveApiConnection() {
            if (availableModels.length === 0) return false;
            var idx = Math.min(currentModelIndex, availableModels.length - 1);
            var active = availableModels[idx];
            if (active.provider === "gemini" && (!geminiApiKey || geminiApiKey.trim() === "")) {
                apiWarningBanner = "⚠ CHƯA CÓ GEMINI API KEY: Hãy mở [⚙ Cài đặt] để nhập hoặc dán khóa.";
                return false;
            }
            if (active.provider === "claude" && (!anthropicApiKey || anthropicApiKey.trim() === "")) {
                apiWarningBanner = "⚠ CHƯA CÓ CLAUDE API KEY: Hãy mở [⚙ Cài đặt] để nhập hoặc dán khóa.";
                return false;
            }
            if (active.provider === "openai" && (!openaiApiKey || openaiApiKey.trim() === "")) {
                apiWarningBanner = "⚠ CHƯA CÓ OPENAI API KEY: Hãy mở [⚙ Cài đặt] để nhập hoặc dán khóa.";
                return false;
            }
            apiWarningBanner = "";
            return true;
        }

        function fetchAllAvailableModels() {
            if (isFetchingModels) return;
            isFetchingModels = true;
            modelSyncStatus = "Đang kết nối API để lấy danh sách Models mới nhất...";

            var previousEnabledMap = {};
            for (var p = 0; p < allModelsMaster.length; p++) {
                previousEnabledMap[allModelsMaster[p].id] = allModelsMaster[p].enabled;
            }

            var fetchedList = [];
            var pendingRequests = 0;
            var providerCounts = { "gemini": 0, "claude": 0, "openai": 0 };

            function checkAllFinished() {
                if (pendingRequests <= 0) {
                    isFetchingModels = false;
                    if (fetchedList.length > 0) {
                        allModelsMaster = fetchedList;
                        rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels();
                        modelSyncStatus = "✓ Đã tải " + fetchedList.length + " models (Gemini: " + providerCounts.gemini + ", Claude: " + providerCounts.claude + ", OpenAI: " + providerCounts.openai + ")";
                        showToast("✓ Đã cập nhật " + fetchedList.length + " models từ API!");
                    } else {
                        modelSyncStatus = "⚠ Không lấy được danh sách mới (Kiểm tra Wi-Fi hoặc API Key).";
                        showToast("⚠ Không lấy được danh sách Models mới!");
                    }
                    verifyActiveApiConnection();
                }
            }

            if (geminiApiKey && cleanKeyString(geminiApiKey) !== "") {
                pendingRequests++;
                var xhrGem = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhrGem.open("GET", "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=" + cleanKeyString(geminiApiKey), true);
                xhrGem.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhrGem.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        if (xhrGem.status === 200) {
                            try {
                                var res = JSON.parse(xhrGem.responseText);
                                var models = res.models || [];
                                for (var i = 0; i < models.length; i++) {
                                    var m = models[i];
                                    var methods = m.supportedGenerationMethods || [];
                                    var supportsGen = false;
                                    for (var k = 0; k < methods.length; k++) {
                                        if (methods[k] === "generateContent") supportsGen = true;
                                    }
                                    var rawId = (m.name || "").replace("models/", "").trim();
                                    if (supportsGen && rawId.indexOf("gemini") === 0 && rawId.indexOf("vision") === -1 && rawId.indexOf("embedding") === -1) {
                                        var isFreeTier = (rawId.indexOf("flash") !== -1);
                                        var isEn = (previousEnabledMap[rawId] !== undefined) ? previousEnabledMap[rawId] : true;
                                        var hwMaxOut = m.outputTokenLimit || 8192;
                                        var baseLowOut = hwMaxOut >> 2;
                                        if (baseLowOut < 2048) baseLowOut = 2048;
                                        fetchedList.push({
                                            "label": (m.displayName || rawId) + (isFreeTier ? " (Free)" : ""),
                                            "provider": "gemini",
                                            "id": rawId,
                                            "isFree": isFreeTier,
                                            "enabled": isEn,
                                            "maxOutputTokens": baseLowOut
                                        });
                                        providerCounts.gemini++;
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        pendingRequests--;
                        checkAllFinished();
                    }
                };
                xhrGem.send();
            }

            if (anthropicApiKey && cleanKeyString(anthropicApiKey) !== "") {
                pendingRequests++;
                var xhrCla = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhrCla.open("GET", "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models", true);
                xhrCla.setRequestHeader("x-api-key", cleanKeyString(anthropicApiKey));
                xhrCla.setRequestHeader("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01");
                xhrCla.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhrCla.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        if (xhrCla.status === 200) {
                            try {
                                var res = JSON.parse(xhrCla.responseText);
                                var data = res.data || [];
                                for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                                    var cm = data[i];
                                    if (cm.id && cm.id.indexOf("claude") === 0) {
                                        var cid = cm.id.trim();
                                        var isHaiku = (cid.indexOf("haiku") !== -1);
                                        var isEn = (previousEnabledMap[cid] !== undefined) ? previousEnabledMap[cid] : true;
                                        fetchedList.push({
                                            "label": cm.display_name || cid,
                                            "provider": "claude",
                                            "id": cid,
                                            "isFree": isHaiku,
                                            "enabled": isEn,
                                            "maxOutputTokens": 2048
                                        });
                                        providerCounts.claude++;
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        pendingRequests--;
                        checkAllFinished();
                    }
                };
                xhrCla.send();
            }

            if (openaiApiKey && cleanKeyString(openaiApiKey) !== "") {
                pendingRequests++;
                var xhrOai = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhrOai.open("GET", "https://api.openai.com/v1/models", true);
                xhrOai.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + cleanKeyString(openaiApiKey));
                xhrOai.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhrOai.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        if (xhrOai.status === 200) {
                            try {
                                var res = JSON.parse(xhrOai.responseText);
                                var data = res.data || [];
                                for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                                    var oid = (data[i].id || "").trim();
                                    var isChatModel = (oid.indexOf("gpt-4") === 0 || oid.indexOf("gpt-3.5") === 0 || oid.indexOf("o1") === 0 || oid.indexOf("o3") === 0 || oid.indexOf("o4") === 0 || oid.indexOf("chatgpt-") === 0);
                                    var isExcluded = (oid.indexOf("audio") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("realtime") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("tts") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("transcribe") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("embedding") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("instruct") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("vision") !== -1);
                                    if (isChatModel && !isExcluded) {
                                        var isMini = (oid.indexOf("mini") !== -1 || oid.indexOf("nano") !== -1);
                                        var isEn = (previousEnabledMap[oid] !== undefined) ? previousEnabledMap[oid] : true;
                                        fetchedList.push({
                                            "label": "OpenAI: " + oid,
                                            "provider": "openai",
                                            "id": oid,
                                            "isFree": isMini,
                                            "enabled": isEn,
                                            "maxOutputTokens": 1500
                                        });
                                        providerCounts.openai++;
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e) {}
                        }
                        pendingRequests--;
                        checkAllFinished();
                    }
                };
                xhrOai.send();
            }

            if (pendingRequests === 0) {
                isFetchingModels = false;
                modelSyncStatus = "⚠ Vui lòng nhập ít nhất 1 API Key (Gemini / Claude / OpenAI) trước khi quét Models.";
                showToast("⚠ Chưa có API Key để quét Models!");
            }
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // BỘ GÕ TIẾNG VIỆT UNIKEY TELEX ENGINE + BỎ DẤU HAI LẦN VỀ TIẾNG ANH
        // =========================================================================
        property var telexVowelTable: [
            ["a", "á", "à", "ả", "ã", "ạ"],
            ["ă", "ắ", "ằ", "ẳ", "ẵ", "ặ"],
            ["â", "ấ", "ầ", "ẩ", "ẫ", "ậ"],
            ["e", "é", "è", "ẻ", "ẽ", "ẹ"],
            ["ê", "ế", "ề", "ể", "ễ", "ệ"],
            ["i", "í", "ì", "ỉ", "ĩ", "ị"],
            ["o", "ó", "ò", "ỏ", "õ", "ọ"],
            ["ô", "ố", "ồ", "ổ", "ỗ", "ộ"],
            ["ơ", "ớ", "ờ", "ở", "ỡ", "ợ"],
            ["u", "ú", "ù", "ủ", "ũ", "ụ"],
            ["ư", "ứ", "ừ", "ử", "ữ", "ự"],
            ["y", "ý", "ỳ", "ỷ", "ỹ", "ỵ"]
        ]

        function getVowelInfo(ch) {
            var fixedU = ["u", "ú", "ù", "ủ", "ũ", "ụ"];
            for (var r = 0; r < telexVowelTable.length; r++) {
                var row = (r === 9) ? fixedU : telexVowelTable[r];
                for (var t = 0; t < 6; t++) {
                    if (row[t] === ch) return { baseIdx: r, tone: t, isUpper: false };
                    if (row[t].toUpperCase() === ch) return { baseIdx: r, tone: t, isUpper: true };
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        function makeVowelChar(baseIdx, tone, isUpper) {
            var fixedU = ["u", "ú", "ù", "ủ", "ũ", "ụ"];
            var row = (baseIdx === 9) ? fixedU : telexVowelTable[baseIdx];
            var ch = row[tone];
            return isUpper ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch;
        }

        function isModifiedBase(baseIdx) {
            return (baseIdx === 1 || baseIdx === 2 || baseIdx === 4 || baseIdx === 7 || baseIdx === 8 || baseIdx === 10);
        }

        function repositionWordTone(chars, tones, targetTone) {
            var vIndices = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
                var info = getVowelInfo(chars[i]);
                if (info !== null) {
                    if (i === 1 && info.baseIdx === 9 && (chars[0] === "q" || chars[0] === "Q")) {
                        if (i + 1 < chars.length && getVowelInfo(chars[i + 1]) !== null) continue;
                    }
                    if (i === 1 && info.baseIdx === 5 && (chars[0] === "g" || chars[0] === "G")) {
                        if (i + 1 < chars.length && getVowelInfo(chars[i + 1]) !== null) continue;
                    }
                    vIndices.push(i);
                }
            }
            if (vIndices.length === 0) return false;

            for (var j = 0; j < vIndices.length; j++) {
                var idx = vIndices[j];
                var vInfo = getVowelInfo(chars[idx]);
                chars[idx] = makeVowelChar(vInfo.baseIdx, 0, vInfo.isUpper);
            }

            if (targetTone === 0) return true;

            var chosenPos = vIndices[0];
            if (vIndices.length === 1) {
                chosenPos = vIndices[0];
            } else {
                var modPositions = [];
                for (var m = 0; m < vIndices.length; m++) {
                    var mInfo = getVowelInfo(chars[vIndices[m]]);
                    if (isModifiedBase(mInfo.baseIdx)) modPositions.push(vIndices[m]);
                }
                if (modPositions.length > 0) {
                    chosenPos = modPositions[modPositions.length - 1];
                } else if (vIndices.length === 2) {
                    var v0 = getVowelInfo(chars[vIndices[0]]).baseIdx;
                    var v1 = getVowelInfo(chars[vIndices[1]]).baseIdx;
                    var hasEndingConsonant = (vIndices[1] < chars.length - 1);
                    if (v0 === 9 && v1 === 11) {
                        chosenPos = vIndices[1];
                    } else if (hasEndingConsonant) {
                        chosenPos = vIndices[1];
                    } else if ((v0 === 6 && (v1 === 0 || v1 === 3)) || (v0 === 9 && v1 === 4)) {
                        chosenPos = vIndices[1];
                    } else {
                        chosenPos = vIndices[0];
                    }
                } else {
                    chosenPos = vIndices[1];
                }
            }

            var targetInfo = getVowelInfo(chars[chosenPos]);
            chars[chosenPos] = makeVowelChar(targetInfo.baseIdx, targetTone, targetInfo.isUpper);
            return true;
        }

        function processWordWithUniKeyTelex(word, keyChar) {
            var lowerKey = keyChar.toLowerCase();
            var isKeyUpper = (keyChar !== lowerKey);
            var chars = word.split("");

            var currentWordTone = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
                var vi = getVowelInfo(chars[i]);
                if (vi !== null && vi.tone !== 0) {
                    currentWordTone = vi.tone;
                    chars[i] = makeVowelChar(vi.baseIdx, 0, vi.isUpper);
                }
            }

            if (lowerKey === "d" && chars.length >= 1) {
                var lastIdx = chars.length - 1;
                if (chars[lastIdx] === "d" || chars[lastIdx] === "D") {
                    chars[lastIdx] = (chars[lastIdx] === "D") ? "Đ" : "đ";
                    repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                    return chars.join("");
                }
                if (chars[lastIdx] === "đ" || chars[lastIdx] === "Đ") {
                    chars[lastIdx] = (chars[lastIdx] === "Đ") ? "D" : "d";
                    chars.push(keyChar);
                    repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                    return chars.join("");
                }
            }

            if (lowerKey === "a" || lowerKey === "e" || lowerKey === "o") {
                var targetBase = (lowerKey === "a") ? 0 : ((lowerKey === "e") ? 3 : 6);
                var circumflexBase = (lowerKey === "a") ? 2 : ((lowerKey === "e") ? 4 : 7);
                for (var c = chars.length - 1; c >= 0; c--) {
                    var cInfo = getVowelInfo(chars[c]);
                    if (cInfo !== null) {
                        if (cInfo.baseIdx === circumflexBase) {
                            chars[c] = makeVowelChar(targetBase, 0, cInfo.isUpper);
                            chars.push(keyChar);
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                        if (cInfo.baseIdx === targetBase) {
                            chars[c] = makeVowelChar(circumflexBase, 0, cInfo.isUpper);
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (lowerKey === "w") {
                if (chars.length >= 1) {
                    var lastV = getVowelInfo(chars[chars.length - 1]);
                    if (lastV !== null && lastV.baseIdx === 10) {
                        var prevIsU = (chars.length >= 2 && (chars[chars.length - 2].toLowerCase() === "u"));
                        if (!prevIsU) {
                            chars[chars.length - 1] = lastV.isUpper ? "W" : "w";
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (var m = chars.length - 1; m >= 0; m--) {
                    var mv = getVowelInfo(chars[m]);
                    if (mv !== null && (mv.baseIdx === 1 || mv.baseIdx === 8 || mv.baseIdx === 10)) {
                        var origBase = (mv.baseIdx === 1) ? 0 : ((mv.baseIdx === 8) ? 6 : 9);
                        chars[m] = makeVowelChar(origBase, 0, mv.isUpper);
                        if (m >= 1) {
                            var prevU = getVowelInfo(chars[m - 1]);
                            if (prevU !== null && prevU.baseIdx === 10) {
                                chars[m - 1] = makeVowelChar(9, 0, prevU.isUpper);
                            }
                        }
                        chars.push(keyChar);
                        repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                        return chars.join("");
                    }
                }

                for (var u = 0; u < chars.length - 1; u++) {
                    var uInfo = getVowelInfo(chars[u]);
                    var oInfo = getVowelInfo(chars[u + 1]);
                    if (uInfo !== null && oInfo !== null && (uInfo.baseIdx === 9 || uInfo.baseIdx === 10) && (oInfo.baseIdx === 6 || oInfo.baseIdx === 7 || oInfo.baseIdx === 8)) {
                        var isQuPrefix = (u === 1 && (chars[0] === "q" || chars[0] === "Q"));
                        if (!isQuPrefix) {
                            chars[u] = makeVowelChar(10, 0, uInfo.isUpper);
                            chars[u + 1] = makeVowelChar(8, 0, oInfo.isUpper);
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (var k = chars.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
                    var kv = getVowelInfo(chars[k]);
                    if (kv !== null) {
                        if (kv.baseIdx === 0) {
                            chars[k] = makeVowelChar(1, 0, kv.isUpper);
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                        if (kv.baseIdx === 6 || kv.baseIdx === 7) {
                            chars[k] = makeVowelChar(8, 0, kv.isUpper);
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                        if (kv.baseIdx === 9) {
                            chars[k] = makeVowelChar(10, 0, kv.isUpper);
                            repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                    }
                }

                var newU = isKeyUpper ? "Ư" : "ư";
                chars.push(newU);
                repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
                return chars.join("");
            }

            var toneMap = { "z": 0, "s": 1, "f": 2, "r": 3, "x": 4, "j": 5 };
            if (toneMap[lowerKey] !== undefined && chars.length >= 1) {
                var hasAnyVowel = false;
                for (var v = 0; v < chars.length; v++) {
                    if (getVowelInfo(chars[v]) !== null) { hasAnyVowel = true; break; }
                }
                if (hasAnyVowel) {
                    var desiredTone = toneMap[lowerKey];
                    if (desiredTone === 0) {
                        if (currentWordTone === 0) {
                            chars.push(keyChar);
                            return chars.join("");
                        }
                        repositionWordTone(chars, null, 0);
                        return chars.join("");
                    }
                    if (currentWordTone === desiredTone) {
                        repositionWordTone(chars, null, 0);
                        chars.push(keyChar);
                        return chars.join("");
                    }
                    repositionWordTone(chars, null, desiredTone);
                    return chars.join("");
                }
            }

            chars.push(keyChar);
            if (currentWordTone !== 0) {
                repositionWordTone(chars, null, currentWordTone);
            }
            return chars.join("");
        }

        function applyVietnameseTelex(currentText, keyChar) {
            if (!telexEnabled) return currentText + keyChar;

            var splitPos = -1;
            for (var i = currentText.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                var c = currentText.charAt(i);
                if (" \n\t.,!?;:()[]{}\"'/-+@#$%^&=<>~`|\\0123456789".indexOf(c) !== -1) {
                    splitPos = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            var prefix = currentText.slice(0, splitPos + 1);
            var activeWord = currentText.slice(splitPos + 1);
            return prefix + processWordWithUniKeyTelex(activeWord, keyChar);
        }

        function handleVirtualKeyPress(k) {
            suppressSystemKeyboard();
            var targetStr = currentDraftText;
            if (activeKeyField === 1) targetStr = geminiApiKey;
            else if (activeKeyField === 2) targetStr = anthropicApiKey;
            else if (activeKeyField === 3) targetStr = openaiApiKey;
            else if (activeKeyField === 4) targetStr = modelSearchQuery;

            if (k === "BACKSPACE") {
                if (targetStr.length > 0) targetStr = targetStr.slice(0, targetStr.length - 1);
            } else if (k === "SPACE") {
                targetStr = targetStr + " ";
            } else if (k === "SHIFT") {
                shiftActive = !shiftActive;
                return;
            } else if (k === "TELEX") {
                telexEnabled = !telexEnabled;
                return;
            } else if (k === "SYM_TOGGLE") {
                symbolPageActive = !symbolPageActive;
                return;
            } else if (k === "CLEAR") {
                targetStr = "";
            } else {
                var outChar = k;
                if (!symbolPageActive && k.length === 1 && k.toLowerCase() !== k.toUpperCase()) {
                    outChar = shiftActive ? k.toUpperCase() : k.toLowerCase();
                }
                if ((activeKeyField === 0 || activeKeyField === 4) && !symbolPageActive && outChar.toLowerCase() !== outChar.toUpperCase()) {
                    targetStr = applyVietnameseTelex(targetStr, outChar);
                } else {
                    targetStr = targetStr + outChar;
                }
                if (shiftActive) shiftActive = false;
            }

            if (activeKeyField === 0) currentDraftText = targetStr;
            else if (activeKeyField === 1) { geminiApiKey = cleanKeyString(targetStr); verifyActiveApiConnection(); }
            else if (activeKeyField === 2) { anthropicApiKey = cleanKeyString(targetStr); verifyActiveApiConnection(); }
            else if (activeKeyField === 3) { openaiApiKey = cleanKeyString(targetStr); verifyActiveApiConnection(); }
            else if (activeKeyField === 4) { modelSearchQuery = targetStr; rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels(); }
        }

        function pasteFromClipboardToField(fieldIdx) {
            hiddenClipboardBridge.text = "";
            hiddenClipboardBridge.paste();
            var clip = (hiddenClipboardBridge.text || "").trim();
            if (clip === "") { showToast("Clipboard đang trống!"); return; }
            if (fieldIdx === 1) geminiApiKey = cleanKeyString(clip);
            else if (fieldIdx === 2) anthropicApiKey = cleanKeyString(clip);
            else if (fieldIdx === 3) openaiApiKey = cleanKeyString(clip);
            else if (fieldIdx === 4) { modelSearchQuery = clip; rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels(); }
            else currentDraftText = currentDraftText + clip;
            verifyActiveApiConnection();
            showToast("✓ Đã dán nội dung từ Clipboard!");
        }

        function isQuotaOrTokenExhausted(httpStatus, responseBody) {
            if (httpStatus === 429 || httpStatus === 402) return true;
            var lower = (responseBody || "").toLowerCase();
            return (lower.indexOf("quota") !== -1 ||
                    lower.indexOf("rate_limit") !== -1 ||
                    lower.indexOf("insufficient") !== -1 ||
                    lower.indexOf("credit balance") !== -1 ||
                    lower.indexOf("resource_exhausted") !== -1 ||
                    lower.indexOf("billing") !== -1);
        }

        function findAvailableFreeModelIndex(failedModelIdx) {
            for (var i = 0; i < availableModels.length; i++) {
                if (i !== failedModelIdx && availableModels[i].isFree) {
                    var p = availableModels[i].provider;
                    if (p === "gemini" && geminiApiKey.trim() !== "") return i;
                    if (p === "openai" && openaiApiKey.trim() !== "") return i;
                    if (p === "claude" && anthropicApiKey.trim() !== "") return i;
                }
            }
            return -1;
        }

        Timer {
            id: toastClearTimer
            interval: 4000; repeat: false
            onTriggered: { aiOverlayRoot.saveStatusToast = ""; }
        }

        // Bộ hẹn giờ ngắt an toàn khi mạng chập chờn (Chống treo luồng truyền tải)
        Timer {
            id: requestSafetyTimeoutTimer
            interval: 60000; repeat: false
            onTriggered: {
                if (aiOverlayRoot.isSending && aiOverlayRoot.activeXhrRequest) {
                    try { aiOverlayRoot.activeXhrRequest.abort(); } catch (e) {}
                    aiOverlayRoot.isSending = false;
                    aiOverlayRoot.showToast("⚠ Quá thời gian phản hồi (60s). Vui lòng thử lại!");
                }
            }
        }

        function showToast(msg) {
            aiOverlayRoot.saveStatusToast = msg;
            toastClearTimer.restart();
        }

        function copyTextToClipboard(textToCopy, closeAfterCopy) {
            if (!textToCopy) return;
            hiddenClipboardBridge.text = textToCopy;
            hiddenClipboardBridge.selectAll();
            hiddenClipboardBridge.copy();
            if (closeAfterCopy) {
                aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible = false;
                aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = false;
                aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible = false;
                aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible = false;
            } else {
                showToast("✓ Đã chép vào Clipboard!");
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: selectionWatcher
            interval: 350; running: !aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible; repeat: true
            onTriggered: aiOverlayRoot.detectSelectionAndMenu()
        }

        function detectSelectionAndMenu() {
            var activeText = "";
            var menuDetected = false;
            var targetX = aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorX;
            var targetY = aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorY;

            function scanTree(item, depth) {
                if (!item || depth > 9 || item === aiOverlayRoot) return;
                try {
                    if (item.selectedText && typeof item.selectedText === "string" && item.selectedText.trim() !== "") {
                        activeText = item.selectedText.trim();
                    }
                    if (item.visible && item.width >= 110 && item.width <= 620 && item.height >= 48 && item.height <= 115) {
                        var pos = item.mapToItem(aiOverlayRoot, 0, 0);
                        if (pos.y > 90 && pos.y < (aiOverlayRoot.height - 100) && pos.x > 60) {
                            var strName = item.toString();
                            if (strName.indexOf("Selection") !== -1 || strName.indexOf("Menu") !== -1 || strName.indexOf("Popup") !== -1 || strName.indexOf("Toolbar") !== -1 || activeText !== "") {
                                menuDetected = true;
                                targetX = Math.max(20, Math.min(aiOverlayRoot.width - 420, pos.x));
                                targetY = (pos.y + item.height + 80 < aiOverlayRoot.height) ? (pos.y + item.height + 10) : (pos.y - 74);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
                if (item.children) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < item.children.length; i++) scanTree(item.children[i], depth + 1);
                }
            }
            scanTree(aiOverlayRoot.parent, 0);
            if (activeText !== "") {
                aiOverlayRoot.quotedSelection = activeText;
                aiOverlayRoot.selectionMenuActive = true;
                aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorX = targetX;
                aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorY = targetY;
            } else if (menuDetected) {
                aiOverlayRoot.selectionMenuActive = true;
                aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorX = targetX;
                aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorY = targetY;
            } else {
                aiOverlayRoot.selectionMenuActive = false;
            }
        }

        function grabHighlightedText() {
            var foundText = "";
            function scanNode(item, depth) {
                if (!item || depth > 8 || foundText !== "" || item === aiOverlayRoot) return;
                try {
                    if (item.selectedText && typeof item.selectedText === "string" && item.selectedText.trim() !== "") {
                        foundText = item.selectedText.trim();
                        return;
                    }
                    if (typeof item.copySelectionToClipboard === "function") item.copySelectionToClipboard();
                } catch (e) {}
                if (item.children) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < item.children.length; i++) scanNode(item.children[i], depth + 1);
                }
            }
            scanNode(aiOverlayRoot.parent, 0);
            if (foundText === "") {
                hiddenClipboardBridge.text = "";
                hiddenClipboardBridge.paste();
                if (hiddenClipboardBridge.text) foundText = hiddenClipboardBridge.text.trim();
            }
            if (foundText !== "") quotedSelection = foundText;
        }

        function triggerFromContextMenu(autoPrompt) {
            suppressSystemKeyboard();
            loadApiKeysDirectlyFromTxt(false);
            grabHighlightedText();
            selectionMenuActive = false;
            chatVisible = true;
            settingsPageVisible = false;
            notebookPageVisible = false;
            modelMenuVisible = false;
            saveMenuVisible = false;
            activeKeyField = 0;
            if (autoPrompt) sendPrompt(autoPrompt, false);
        }

        function buildValidClaudeMessages() {
            var validMsgs = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < conversationHistory.length; i++) {
                var r = (conversationHistory[i].role === "assistant") ? "assistant" : "user";
                var txt = (conversationHistory[i].text || "").trim();
                if (txt === "") continue;
                if (validMsgs.length === 0 && r !== "user") continue;

                if (validMsgs.length > 0 && validMsgs[validMsgs.length - 1].role === r) {
                    validMsgs[validMsgs.length - 1].content = validMsgs[validMsgs.length - 1].content + "\n\n" + txt;
                } else {
                    validMsgs.push({ "role": r, "content": txt });
                }
            }
            return validMsgs;
        }

        function sendPrompt(userPrompt, isRetryAfterFallback) {
            suppressSystemKeyboard();
            if (!isRetryAfterFallback) {
                if ((!userPrompt || userPrompt.trim() === "") && quotedSelection === "") return;
                if (isSending) return;
            }

            if (!verifyActiveApiConnection()) {
                chatLogModel.append({
                    "sender": "Cảnh báo kết nối API",
                    "msgText": apiWarningBanner,
                    "copied": false
                });
                chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
                return;
            }

            isSending = true;
            modelMenuVisible = false;
            saveMenuVisible = false;

            var activeModel = availableModels[currentModelIndex];
            var dynamicMaxTokens = computeEffectiveMaxTokens(activeModel);
            var effectiveSysPrompt = buildEffectiveSystemInstruction();

            if (!isRetryAfterFallback) {
                var finalPrompt = userPrompt ? userPrompt.trim() : "Hãy giải thích đoạn văn bản này.";
                if (quotedSelection !== "") {
                    finalPrompt = "Đoạn văn bản trích từ sách:\n\"\"\"\n" + quotedSelection + "\n\"\"\"\n\nYêu cầu: " + finalPrompt;
                    quotedSelection = "";
                }
                conversationHistory.push({ "role": "user", "text": finalPrompt });
                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": "Bạn", "msgText": finalPrompt, "copied": false });
                currentDraftText = "";
            }

            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            activeXhrRequest = xhr;
            requestSafetyTimeoutTimer.restart();

            function handleApiErrorAndFallback(status, responseText) {
                requestSafetyTimeoutTimer.stop();
                isSending = false;
                if (status === 0) {
                    apiWarningBanner = "⚠ MẤT KẾT NỐI MẠNG: Vui lòng kiểm tra Wi-Fi trên reMarkable.";
                    chatLogModel.append({ "sender": "Lỗi mạng", "msgText": apiWarningBanner, "copied": false });
                    chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
                    return;
                }

                if (!isRetryAfterFallback && !activeModel.isFree && isQuotaOrTokenExhausted(status, responseText)) {
                    var freeIdx = findAvailableFreeModelIndex(currentModelIndex);
                    if (freeIdx !== -1) {
                        var oldLabel = activeModel.label;
                        var newLabel = availableModels[freeIdx].label;
                        currentModelIndex = freeIdx;
                        tokenWarningBanner = "⚠ HẾT TOKEN: [" + oldLabel + "] đã hết hạn mức. Đã tự động chuyển sang [" + newLabel + "]!";
                        chatLogModel.append({
                            "sender": "Hệ thống (Auto-Fallback)",
                            "msgText": tokenWarningBanner + " Đang gửi lại câu hỏi...",
                            "copied": false
                        });
                        chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
                        sendPrompt("", true);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                var errDetail = responseText || "Vui lòng mở [⚙ Cài đặt] và kiểm tra lại API Key.";
                try {
                    var parsedErr = JSON.parse(responseText);
                    if (parsedErr.error && parsedErr.error.message) {
                        errDetail = parsedErr.error.message;
                    }
                } catch (e) {}

                chatLogModel.append({
                    "sender": "Lỗi " + activeModel.label + " (" + status + ")",
                    "msgText": errDetail,
                    "copied": false
                });
                chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
            }

            if (activeModel.provider === "claude") {
                xhr.open("POST", "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", true);
                xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8");
                xhr.setRequestHeader("x-api-key", cleanKeyString(anthropicApiKey));
                xhr.setRequestHeader("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01");

                var claudeMsgs = buildValidClaudeMessages();

                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        requestSafetyTimeoutTimer.stop();
                        if (xhr.status === 200) {
                            isSending = false;
                            try {
                                var res = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                                var reply = "";
                                if (res.content && res.content.length > 0) {
                                    for (var c = 0; c < res.content.length; c++) {
                                        if (res.content[c].text) {
                                            reply += res.content[c].text;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reply === "") reply = "(Claude trả về phản hồi trống)";
                                conversationHistory.push({ "role": "assistant", "text": reply });
                                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": activeModel.label, "msgText": reply, "copied": false });
                                saveCurrentChatToQMLNotebook(true);
                            } catch (e) {
                                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": "Hệ thống", "msgText": "Lỗi phân tích JSON từ Claude.", "copied": false });
                            }
                            chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
                        } else {
                            handleApiErrorAndFallback(xhr.status, xhr.responseText);
                        }
                    }
                };
                xhr.send(JSON.stringify({
                    "model": activeModel.id.trim(),
                    "max_tokens": dynamicMaxTokens,
                    "system": effectiveSysPrompt,
                    "messages": claudeMsgs
                }));

            } else if (activeModel.provider === "gemini") {
                var geminiUrl = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/" + activeModel.id.trim() + ":generateContent?key=" + cleanKeyString(geminiApiKey);
                xhr.open("POST", geminiUrl, true);
                xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8");

                var geminiContents = [];
                for (var j = 0; j < conversationHistory.length; j++) {
                    var gRole = conversationHistory[j].role === "assistant" ? "model" : "user";
                    var gTxt = (conversationHistory[j].text || "").trim();
                    if (gTxt === "") continue;
                    if (geminiContents.length > 0 && geminiContents[geminiContents.length - 1].role === gRole) {
                        geminiContents[geminiContents.length - 1].parts[0].text += "\n\n" + gTxt;
                    } else {
                        geminiContents.push({ "role": gRole, "parts": [{ "text": gTxt }] });
                    }
                }

                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        requestSafetyTimeoutTimer.stop();
                        if (xhr.status === 200) {
                            isSending = false;
                            try {
                                var res = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                                var reply = "";
                                var partsList = res.candidates[0].content.parts || [];
                                for (var p = 0; p < partsList.length; p++) {
                                    if (partsList[p].text) reply += partsList[p].text;
                                }
                                conversationHistory.push({ "role": "assistant", "text": reply });
                                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": activeModel.label, "msgText": reply, "copied": false });
                                saveCurrentChatToQMLNotebook(true);
                            } catch (e) {
                                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": "Hệ thống", "msgText": "Lỗi phân tích JSON từ Gemini.", "copied": false });
                            }
                            chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
                        } else {
                            handleApiErrorAndFallback(xhr.status, xhr.responseText);
                        }
                    }
                };
                xhr.send(JSON.stringify({
                    "systemInstruction": { "parts": [{ "text": effectiveSysPrompt }] },
                    "contents": geminiContents,
                    "generationConfig": { "maxOutputTokens": dynamicMaxTokens }
                }));

            } else if (activeModel.provider === "openai") {
                xhr.open("POST", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", true);
                xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8");
                xhr.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + cleanKeyString(openaiApiKey));

                var oaiMsgs = [{ "role": "system", "content": effectiveSysPrompt }];
                for (var k = 0; k < conversationHistory.length; k++) {
                    oaiMsgs.push({ "role": conversationHistory[k].role, "content": conversationHistory[k].text });
                }

                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        requestSafetyTimeoutTimer.stop();
                        if (xhr.status === 200) {
                            isSending = false;
                            try {
                                var res = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                                var reply = res.choices[0].message.content;
                                conversationHistory.push({ "role": "assistant", "text": reply });
                                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": activeModel.label, "msgText": reply, "copied": false });
                                saveCurrentChatToQMLNotebook(true);
                            } catch (e) {
                                chatLogModel.append({ "sender": "Hệ thống", "msgText": "Lỗi phân tích JSON từ OpenAI.", "copied": false });
                            }
                            chatListView.positionViewAtEnd();
                        } else {
                            handleApiErrorAndFallback(xhr.status, xhr.responseText);
                        }
                    }
                };
                xhr.send(JSON.stringify({
                    "model": activeModel.id.trim(),
                    "messages": oaiMsgs,
                    "max_tokens": dynamicMaxTokens
                }));
            }
        }

        // Thanh nút nổi khi bôi đen văn bản
        Rectangle {
            id: contextSelectionPill
            visible: aiOverlayRoot.selectionMenuActive && !aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible
            x: aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorX; y: aiOverlayRoot.popupAnchorY
            width: contextRow.implicitWidth + 20; height: 62; radius: 10
            color: "black"; border.color: "white"; border.width: 2

            Row {
                id: contextRow; anchors.centerIn: parent; spacing: 8
                Rectangle {
                    width: 124; height: 46; radius: 6; color: "white"
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "✦ Hỏi AI"; color: "black"; font.pixelSize: 20; font.bold: true }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.triggerFromContextMenu("") }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    width: 124; height: 46; radius: 6; color: "black"; border.color: "white"; border.width: 2
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Giải thích"; color: "white"; font.pixelSize: 19; font.bold: true }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.triggerFromContextMenu("Hãy giải thích chi tiết và dễ hiểu ý nghĩa của đoạn văn bản này.") }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    width: 110; height: 46; radius: 6; color: "black"; border.color: "white"; border.width: 2
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Dịch TV"; color: "white"; font.pixelSize: 19; font.bold: true }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.triggerFromContextMenu("Dịch đoạn văn bản này sang tiếng Việt tự nhiên, chuẩn thuật ngữ.") }
                }
            }
        }

        // Nút AI cố định góc dưới phải
        Rectangle {
            id: toggleBtn
            width: 84; height: 84; radius: 14
            color: aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible ? "black" : "white"
            border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
            anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
            anchors.rightMargin: 28; anchors.bottomMargin: 28

            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "AI"; font.pixelSize: 28; font.bold: true; color: aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible ? "white" : "black" }
            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: {
                    aiOverlayRoot.suppressSystemKeyboard();
                    aiOverlayRoot.loadApiKeysDirectlyFromTxt(false);
                    if (!aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible) aiOverlayRoot.grabHighlightedText();
                    aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible = !aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible;
                    aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = false;
                    aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                }
            }
        }

        // CỬA SỔ PHIÊN LÀM VIỆC CHÍNH (Tự động co giãn theo cấu hình thiết bị từ Script cài đặt)
        Rectangle {
            id: chatWindow
            visible: aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible
            width: Math.min(parent.width - 40, persistentSettings.customWinWidth)
            height: Math.min(parent.height - 40, persistentSettings.customWinHeight)
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 4; radius: 12

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: {
                    aiOverlayRoot.suppressSystemKeyboard();
                    aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = false;
                    aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                }
            }
            // Vùng chứa cố định cho các đối tượng Extension (.qml)
            Item {
                id: extensionHostContainer
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 95
            }
            // THANH HEADER
            Rectangle {
                id: headerBar
                width: parent.width; height: 84; color: "black"; anchors.top: parent.top; z: 20

                // Nút chọn Model
                Rectangle {
                    width: 285; height: 54; radius: 8; color: "white"
                    anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 12; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text {
                        anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 10; anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.rightMargin: 8
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; elide: Text.ElideRight
                        text: aiOverlayRoot.isSending ? "Đang xử lý..." : ((aiOverlayRoot.availableModels.length > 0 ? aiOverlayRoot.availableModels[aiOverlayRoot.currentModelIndex].label : "Chọn Model") + " ▾")
                        color: "black"; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = !aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Nút mở Sổ tay QML (Xem lại lịch sử ngay trên máy)
                Rectangle {
                    width: 140; height: 54; radius: 8
                    color: aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible ? "#CCCCCC" : "white"
                    anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 305; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                        text: aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible ? "← Quay lại" : ("📚 Sổ tay (" + savedNotebookModel.count + ")")
                        font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.selectedNotebookIndex = -1;
                            aiOverlayRoot.initAndLoadNotebookDB();
                            aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible = !aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Nút Cài đặt
                Rectangle {
                    width: 135; height: 54; radius: 8
                    color: aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible ? "#CCCCCC" : "white"
                    anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 453; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                        text: aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible ? "← Quay lại" : "⚙ Cài đặt"
                        font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible = !aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible;
                            if (!aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible) aiOverlayRoot.activeKeyField = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Nút Ẩn/Hiện Bàn phím
                Rectangle {
                    width: 135; height: 54; radius: 8
                    color: aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard ? "white" : "#DDDDDD"
                    anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 596; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                        text: aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard ? "⌨ Phím: BẬT" : "⌨ Phím: TẮT"
                        font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: { aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard = !aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard; }
                    }
                }

                // Nút Dropdown Menu "Tiện ích ▾" (Thay thế nút Lưu / EPUB cũ)
                Rectangle {
                    width: 145; height: 54; radius: 8
                    color: aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible ? "#CCCCCC" : "white"
                    anchors.right: clearBtn.left; anchors.rightMargin: 8; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Tiện ích ▾"; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                    MouseArea {
