                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            aiOverlayRoot.modelMenuVisible = false;
                            aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible = false;
                            if (!aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible) {
                                aiOverlayRoot.rebuildUtilityMenuItems();
                            }
                            aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = !aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Nút Phiên mới
                Rectangle {
                    id: clearBtn
                    width: 104; height: 54; radius: 8; color: "white"
                    anchors.right: closeBtn.left; anchors.rightMargin: 8; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Phiên mới"; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            if (chatLogModel.count > 0) aiOverlayRoot.saveCurrentChatToQMLNotebook(true);
                            chatLogModel.clear();
                            aiOverlayRoot.conversationHistory = [];
                            aiOverlayRoot.tokenWarningBanner = "";
                            aiOverlayRoot.sessionTitle = "Ghi_chu_AI_" + Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(), "yyyyMMdd_hhmmss");
                            aiOverlayRoot.showToast("Đã lưu phiên cũ vào Sổ tay & tạo phiên mới!");
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Nút Đóng
                Rectangle {
                    id: closeBtn
                    width: 50; height: 54; radius: 8; color: "white"
                    anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.rightMargin: 12; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "X"; font.pixelSize: 24; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { aiOverlayRoot.chatVisible = false; aiOverlayRoot.activeKeyField = 0; } }
                }
            }

            // =========================================================================
            // MENU DROPDOWN "TIỆN ÍCH ▾" (DÙNG LISTVIEW PHẲNG GIỐNG HỆT CHỌN MODEL)
            // =========================================================================
            Rectangle {
                id: saveOptionsDropdown
                visible: aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible
                width: 520; height: 480
                anchors.top: headerBar.bottom; anchors.right: headerBar.right; anchors.rightMargin: 66
                color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3; radius: 8; z: 110

                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onClicked: {}
                }

                ListView {
                    anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 8
                    clip: true; spacing: 6
                    model: aiOverlayRoot.utilityMenuItems.length
                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        property var itemData: aiOverlayRoot.utilityMenuItems[index]
                        width: 500; height: 52; radius: 6
                        color: itemData.rowType === "toggle" ? (itemData.isEnabled ? "#EFEFEF" : "white") : "black"
                        border.color: "black"; border.width: itemData.rowType === "toggle" ? 2 : 1

                        Text {
                            anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 14
                            anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.rightMargin: 14
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; elide: Text.ElideRight
                            text: itemData.label
                            font.pixelSize: 18; font.bold: true
                            color: itemData.rowType === "toggle" ? "black" : "white"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: {
                                if (itemData.rowType === "builtin") {
                                    aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                                    if (itemData.actionId === "save_notebook") {
                                        aiOverlayRoot.saveCurrentChatToQMLNotebook(false);
                                    } else if (itemData.actionId === "copy_all") {
                                        aiOverlayRoot.copyTextToClipboard(aiOverlayRoot.buildTranscriptMarkdown(), false);
                                    }
                                } else if (itemData.rowType === "toggle") {
                                    aiOverlayRoot.toggleExtensionEnabled(itemData.extId);
                                } else if (itemData.rowType === "action") {
                                    aiOverlayRoot.saveMenuVisible = false;
                                    aiOverlayRoot.triggerExtensionActionById(itemData.extId, itemData.actionId, null);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            // THANH CẢNH BÁO
            Column {
                id: alertsColumn
                anchors.top: headerBar.bottom
                anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.right: parent.right
                z: 25

                Rectangle {
                    visible: aiOverlayRoot.apiWarningBanner !== ""
                    width: parent.width; height: 48; color: "black"
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: aiOverlayRoot.apiWarningBanner; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "white" }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    visible: aiOverlayRoot.tokenWarningBanner !== ""
                    width: parent.width; height: 50; color: "#EFEFEF"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                    Text {
                        anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.leftMargin: 16; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                        text: aiOverlayRoot.tokenWarningBanner; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                    }
                    Rectangle {

                    }

                Rectangle {

                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: aiOverlayRoot.saveStatusToast; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "black" }

                        font.pixelSize: 19; color: "#555555"; wrapMode: Text.WordWrap; width: parent.width
                    }

                    ListView {

                    Text {

                            Text {

                                font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; font.pixelSize: 17; color: "black"; elide: Text.ElideMiddle

                            }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { aiOverlayRoot.activeKeyField = 1; aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard = true; } }

                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.pasteFromClipboardToField(1) }
                        }

                            MouseArea {

                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.setBulkModelsEnabledForCurrentFilter(false) }

                    Row {

                        Repeater {

                                { "code": "all",    "title": "Tất cả" },

                                { "code": "claude", "title": "Anthropic Claude" },

                            Rectangle {

                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: {
                                        aiOverlayRoot.selectedProviderFilter = modelData.code;
                                        aiOverlayRoot.rebuildActiveAndFilteredModels();
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: parent.width
                        height: aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard ? 340 : 710
                        color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2; radius: 6

                        ListView {
                            id: settingsModelsListView
                            anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 6
                            clip: true; spacing: 6
                            model: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels.length

                            delegate: Rectangle {
                                width: settingsModelsListView.width; height: 50; radius: 6
                                color: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].enabled ? "#F2F2F2" : "white"
                                border.color: "black"; border.width: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].enabled ? 2 : 1

                                Row {
                                    anchors.fill: parent; anchors.leftMargin: 12; anchors.rightMargin: 12; spacing: 12

                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: 36; height: 36; radius: 4
                                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        color: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].enabled ? "black" : "white"
                                        border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                        Text {
                                            anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                            text: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].enabled ? "✓" : ""
                                            font.pixelSize: 22; font.bold: true; color: "white"
                                        }
                                    }

                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: 96; height: 34; radius: 4
                                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 1
                                        Text {
                                            anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                            text: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].provider.toUpperCase()
                                            font.pixelSize: 15; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                                        }
                                    }

                                    Text {
                                        width: parent.width - 180; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; elide: Text.ElideRight
                                        text: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].label + "  (" + aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].id + ")"
                                        font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].enabled
                                        color: "black"
                                    }
                                }

                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: {
                                        aiOverlayRoot.toggleModelEnabledAtMaster(aiOverlayRoot.filteredSettingsModels[index].masterIndex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Row {
                        width: parent.width; spacing: 10
                        Rectangle {
                            width: parent.width - 310; height: 48; radius: 6; color: "#F2F2F2"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 1
                            Text {
                                anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 8; verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                                font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; font.pixelSize: 16; color: "black"; elide: Text.ElideRight
                                text: aiOverlayRoot.modelSyncStatus
                            }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 300; height: 48; radius: 6; color: "black"
                            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "✓ Hoàn tất & Mở màn hình Chat"; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "white" }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    aiOverlayRoot.activeKeyField = 0;
                                    aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible = false;
                                    aiOverlayRoot.verifyActiveApiConnection();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // DANH SÁCH TIN NHẮN HỘI THOẠI (Chống tràn bộ nhớ đệm hiển thị với PlainText & implicitHeight)
            ListView {
                id: chatListView
                visible: !aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible && !aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible
                anchors.top: alertsColumn.bottom
                anchors.bottom: selectionBanner.visible ? selectionBanner.top : inputContainer.top
                anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.margins: 20
                clip: true; spacing: 18; model: chatLogModel
                cacheBuffer: 4000

                delegate: Column {
                    width: chatListView.width; spacing: 6
                    Item {
                        width: parent.width; height: 42
                        Text { anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: model.sender + ":"; font.pixelSize: 21; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                        Row {
                            anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; spacing: 10; visible: model.sender !== "Bạn"
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 125; height: 38; radius: 6; color: model.copied ? "black" : "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: model.copied ? "✓ Đã chép" : "Chép"; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: model.copied ? "white" : "black" }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { aiOverlayRoot.copyTextToClipboard(model.msgText, false); chatLogModel.setProperty(index, "copied", true); } }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 150; height: 38; radius: 6; color: "black"
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Chép & Đóng"; font.pixelSize: 17; font.bold: true; color: "white" }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { chatLogModel.setProperty(index, "copied", true); aiOverlayRoot.copyTextToClipboard(model.msgText, true); } }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        width: parent.width; implicitHeight: msgBody.implicitHeight + 24; height: implicitHeight
                        color: model.sender === "Bạn" ? "#EFEFEF" : "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: model.sender === "Bạn" ? 1 : 2; radius: 8
                        Text {
                            id: msgBody
                            width: parent.width - 24
                            x: 12; y: 12
                            font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                            text: model.msgText
                            textFormat: Text.PlainText
                            font.pixelSize: 23
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            color: "black"
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // KHUNG TRÍCH DẪN VĂN BẢN ĐANG CHỌN
            Rectangle {
                id: selectionBanner
                visible: !aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible && !aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible && aiOverlayRoot.quotedSelection !== ""
                width: parent.width; height: 132; anchors.bottom: inputContainer.top
                color: "#F2F2F2"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2; z: 20
                Text {
                    anchors.top: parent.top; anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.right: clearQuoteBtn.left; anchors.margins: 12
                    font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                    text: "Đoạn đang chọn: \"" + aiOverlayRoot.quotedSelection + "\""; font.pixelSize: 19; font.italic: true
                    elide: Text.ElideRight; maximumLineCount: 2; wrapMode: Text.WordWrap; color: "black"
                }
                Rectangle {
                    id: clearQuoteBtn; width: 42; height: 42; anchors.top: parent.top; anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.margins: 10
                    color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2; radius: 6
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "×"; font.pixelSize: 24; font.bold: true }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.quotedSelection = ""; }
                }
                Row {
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom; anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.margins: 12; spacing: 12
                    Repeater {
                        model: [
                            { "title": "Giải thích chi tiết", "prompt": "Hãy giải thích chi tiết và dễ hiểu ý nghĩa của đoạn văn bản này." },
                            { "title": "Tóm tắt ý chính", "prompt": "Tóm tắt ngắn gọn các luận điểm chính của đoạn văn bản này." },
                            { "title": "Dịch sang Tiếng Việt", "prompt": "Dịch đoạn văn bản này sang tiếng Việt tự nhiên, chuẩn thuật ngữ chuyên ngành." }
                        ]
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 240; height: 46; radius: 8; color: "black"
                            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: modelData.title; color: "white"; font.pixelSize: 19; font.bold: true }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.sendPrompt(modelData.prompt, false) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Ô NHẬP CÂU HỎI TỰ VẼ ("Gõ câu hỏi ...")
            Rectangle {
                id: inputContainer
                visible: !aiOverlayRoot.settingsPageVisible && !aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible
                width: parent.width; height: 92
                anchors.bottom: virtualKeyboardPanel.visible ? virtualKeyboardPanel.top : parent.bottom
                color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2; z: 20

                Rectangle {
                    anchors.left: parent.left; anchors.right: sendBtn.left; anchors.top: parent.top; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom; anchors.margins: 12
                    border.color: "black"; border.width: aiOverlayRoot.activeKeyField === 0 ? 3 : 2; radius: 6
                    color: "white"; clip: true

                    Text {
                        anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 12
                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; font.pixelSize: 23
                        color: aiOverlayRoot.currentDraftText === "" ? "#777777" : "black"
                        text: aiOverlayRoot.currentDraftText === "" ? "Gõ câu hỏi ..." : (aiOverlayRoot.currentDraftText + " ▏")
                        wrapMode: Text.WrapAnywhere; maximumLineCount: 2
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            aiOverlayRoot.suppressSystemKeyboard();
                            aiOverlayRoot.activeKeyField = 0;
                            aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: sendBtn
                    width: 140; anchors.right: parent.right; anchors.top: parent.top; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom; anchors.margins: 12
                    color: "black"; radius: 6
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: aiOverlayRoot.isSending ? "..." : "Gửi"; color: "white"; font.pixelSize: 23; font.bold: true }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.sendPrompt(aiOverlayRoot.currentDraftText, false) }
                }
            }

            // BÀN PHÍM NỔI QWERTY UNIKEY TELEX
            Rectangle {
                id: virtualKeyboardPanel
                visible: aiOverlayRoot.showVirtualKeyboard && !aiOverlayRoot.notebookPageVisible
                width: parent.width; height: 396
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                color: "#EEEEEE"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3; z: 35

                Column {
                    anchors.fill: parent; anchors.margins: 8; spacing: 7

                    Row {
                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; spacing: 8
                        Repeater {
                            model: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? ["!","@","#","$","%","^","&","+","(",")"] : ["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8","9","0"]
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 98; height: 50; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: modelData; font.pixelSize: 22; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress(modelData) }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Row {
                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; spacing: 8
                        Repeater {
                            model: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? ["-","_","=","+","[","]","{","}","\\","|"] : ["q","w","e","r","t","y","u","i","o","p"]
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 98; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                    text: (!aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive && aiOverlayRoot.shiftActive) ? modelData.toUpperCase() : modelData
                                    font.pixelSize: 24; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress(modelData) }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Row {
                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; spacing: 8
                        Repeater {
                            model: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? [";",":","'","\"","<",">","/","?","~","`"] : ["a","s","d","f","g","h","j","k","l","?"]
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 98; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                    text: (!aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive && aiOverlayRoot.shiftActive) ? modelData.toUpperCase() : modelData
                                    font.pixelSize: 24; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress(modelData) }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Row {
                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; spacing: 8
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 114; height: 54; radius: 6
                            color: aiOverlayRoot.shiftActive ? "black" : "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Shift"; font.pixelSize: 20; font.bold: true; color: aiOverlayRoot.shiftActive ? "white" : "black" }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress("SHIFT") }
                        }
                        Repeater {
                            model: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? ["•","€","£","¥","©","®","±","×","÷"] : ["z","x","c","v","b","n","m",",","."]
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 86; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                    text: (!aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive && aiOverlayRoot.shiftActive) ? modelData.toUpperCase() : modelData
                                    font.pixelSize: 24; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress(modelData) }
                            }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 114; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Xóa lùi"; font.pixelSize: 20; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress("BACKSPACE") }
                        }
                    }

                    Row {
                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; spacing: 8
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 130; height: 54; radius: 6
                            color: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? "black" : "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                text: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? "ABC" : "#+="
                                font.pixelSize: 20; font.bold: true; color: aiOverlayRoot.symbolPageActive ? "white" : "black"
                            }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress("SYM_TOGGLE") }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 175; height: 54; radius: 6
                            color: aiOverlayRoot.telexEnabled ? "black" : "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                text: aiOverlayRoot.telexEnabled ? "Gõ: VI Telex" : "Gõ: Tiếng Anh"
                                font.pixelSize: 19; font.bold: true; color: aiOverlayRoot.telexEnabled ? "white" : "black"
                            }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress("TELEX") }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 115; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Xóa hết"; font.pixelSize: 18; font.bold: true; color: "black" }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress("CLEAR") }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 440; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont
                                text: aiOverlayRoot.telexEnabled ? "Dấu cách" : "Space (English)"
                                font.pixelSize: 19; font.bold: true; color: "black"
                            }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.handleVirtualKeyPress("SPACE") }
                        }
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 180; height: 54; radius: 6; color: "black"
                            Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; font.family: aiOverlayRoot.vnFont; text: "Gửi câu hỏi"; font.pixelSize: 19; font.bold: true; color: "white" }
                            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: aiOverlayRoot.sendPrompt(aiOverlayRoot.currentDraftText, false) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
